note: Declares WHAT KINDS of datum are measured, never WHICH instances. Every recognition rule and binding form below is a lexical observable statable without reading this corpus; none reports what the corpus contains. See measurement-contract.md 1.2.

families.recognition: A maximal run of 7 to 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters whose immediate neighbours on both sides are neither alphanumeric nor U+2026, and whose left neighbour is not a hyphen. A run longer than 40 is not a citation and no window inside it is one.
A token of the form plugin-<package>-v<major>.<minor>.<patch>, optionally enclosed in code delimiters. The package segment is read from the token, never from a list.
A number sign immediately followed by 2 to 4 decimal digits, terminated by a non-word character. A link wrapper around it does not change the occurrence; the span is the number-sign token itself.
A token of the form <kind>-<YYYYMMDD>T<HHMMSS>Z-<lowercase hex>, where <kind> is read from the token. Its date component is part of the identifier and is never separately an iso-date occurrence.
A token of the form <YYYY>-<MM>-<DD> bounded by non-word characters, excluding any occurrence wholly inside a proof-run-id span.

A run of more than 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters, OR such a run introduced by a field name ending in _sha256 or by the prefix sha256:. Both lexical shapes denote the same family; a producer that recognises only one is incomplete, and a run of this length is never a commit-citation.
A token of the form <major>.<minor>.<patch> bounded by characters that are not word characters, hyphens, or full stops, and not wholly inside a package-tag span.
families.note: Declared not-required: an accepted decision records that binding a bare semver to a package was attempted and withdrawn as undecidable. It is measured so a producer emitting it is not charged with an unexpected occurrence, and it decides no verdict.

relations.note: Roles are bound by the minimal binding span of contract 4.2, not by position or distance. Every role family is bound to this relation's profile, which contract 4.1 requires.

expected_zero_note: Empty by measurement, not by omission. Every family above was measured to occur in both profiles at the pinned commit, so no (family, profile) pair genuinely expects none. An earlier revision declared content-digest as expecting zero in stage-docs; that was false — the family has two lexical shapes and the unprefixed one does occur there. The mechanism stays for a family that later needs it, and contract 3.4 keeps an undeclared zero a `missed`.
